name: maath
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Math helpers for R3F: easing, damping, random, buffers and vector utilities
summary: pmndrs utility collection: easing and damping functions, seeded random distributions, buffer and matrix helpers, geometry points-in-shapes. Imported as an ES module inside a Three.js or R3F scene. Its one strength is frame-rate-independent damping helpers aimed at R3F's useFrame loop.
use_when: R3F scenes already using useFrame that want damp/easing helpers without writing them
avoid_when: Matrix and vector maths outside Three: gl-matrix is the maintained standard
Tweening with seekable time: GSAP or Motion sample from t
Seeded randomness only: a small PRNG is simpler than a dependency

assessment.rationale: Last npm release July 2024 (about 28 months). Overlaps glmatrix for maths and GSAP/Motion for easing; damping helpers depend on delta-time loops, which VCR replaces with seek-by-t.

notes: 2026-10-26: repo commit dates were not shown by the fetched page; maintenance judged from npm release date only.
